request.text: Remind me before I leave to return those boots—the usual amount of time ahead is fine.

responsibilities.outcome: Obtain a user-resolvable due time for a reminder to return the referenced boots before departure, because neither the departure time nor the usual lead time is available.

interpretation_unresolved: The reminder due time cannot be resolved because the departure time and the user’s usual lead time are both absent.

semantic_facts: The planner should ask a concise, user-resolvable question for the departure time, the desired lead time, or an exact reminder time.
No reminder step is executable until due_at can be grounded from the user’s answer.
forbidden_claims: The planner invents a conventional lead time, silently selects a due time, or says the reminder was created.

target.claim_boundary: assistant-authored candidate oracle; not independently reviewed

negative_hypotheses: A required due-time argument is synthesized from an unsupported personal default.
An unresolved stateful request leaks into executable work instead of a genuine clarification.
